newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet has FIM 170 mln paper machine order.
newsitem.headline: Valmet has FIM 170 mln paper machine order.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it won an order worth more than 170 million markka to deliver a new fine paper machine to South Korean company Shinmoorim Paper Mfg. Co. Ltd.
The machine, due to come on stream at Shinmoorim's Chinjun plant early in 1998, will have an annual output capacity of 200,000 tonnes of fine paper, Valmet said.
"The value of the order is over 170 million markka," it added.
Shinmoorim is part of South Korea's Moorim Paper group, which operates three paper mills, Valmet said.
The new contract is Valmet's 14th complete new machine order from South Korea during the 1990s, it said.
